name: Yatagarasu
author: 0xSrcAura
description: Each notification arrives as a Kasugai dispatch scroll: a dark glass plate with a lit priority edge (LOW cyan, MEDIUM emerald, HIGH amber, CRITICAL rose), the sender's icon, the message in mono, and a burn line along the foot that spends the card's remaining life. A critical card does not burn; it waits, marked ACK REQUIRED, until acknowledged. Pictures ride framed in the card, long messages unfold in place, the card mirrors for the left column and centres for the middle column, and a sender may set any of the four priorities through the x-jurai-priority hint.
